evidence.description: FTC consent orders (2022) required clinic divestitures and imposed prior-approval and prior-notice conditions on JAB's future specialty and emergency vet acquisitions (the SAGE and Ethos matters).

JAB was the subject of a 2024 US Senate inquiry by Sens. Warren and Blumenthal into consolidation and post-acquisition price increases at private equity owned veterinary clinics. NVA is JAB's largest veterinary platform.
